about: wl-preproc's Engbert-Kliegl saccade detector as of v1: gaze in degrees per axis, velocity per axis (velocity.py), the median scale and elliptic test (engbert_kliegl.py), an interval's size between its first and last samples by hypot (measure.amplitude). Samples are evenly spaced at fs_hz from t = 0. available: null where a detector may label, else the label the mask gave. A run is [start, stop) in samples. Never edited; a change of behaviour is the next version.
